arms.definition: Current production compression, Main continuity adapter, TaskSystem rehydration and owner validation; no policy repair.
Existing verified observation masking before the same current owner pipeline; minChars=1000, preserveNewestObservationCount=0. Archive and recall are charged actions.
Only bounded working-view editing; no runtime code or result in C01.
Full conditional strategy; no runtime code or result in C01.

grader.input: Trace observations from actual owner calls and filesystem readback; expected assertions are inaccessible to the continuation executor. Missing observation => unknown. Exact JSON equality; no keyword scoring.
grader.passingControlRequirement: Every corrupted observable is rejected; no control contributes a live sample.

liveProtocol.matching: Same original task/environment checkpoint, source/candidate, tools, effective backend, model parameters, raw inputs and remaining action/time budgets; randomize arm order in task blocks and isolate caches/stores. Bind missing live identities before any call; no fallback or substitution.
liveProtocol.splitUnit: Original task/trajectory and its revisions form one cluster. Assign sha256(datasetVersion + originalTaskId) modulo 10: 0..5 train, 6..7 development, 8..9 final. No paraphrase or retry crosses split. Freeze corpus hashes and eligibility before dispatch.
liveProtocol.holdout: No prompt/experience/threshold tuning from final holdout; first terminal attempt retained. Retry costs attach to original cluster, never a new sample.

quality.metric: independent completed-task binary grade after continuation
quality.rationale: At most two additional failed tasks per 100; safety/authority violations remain zero-tolerance, not averaged. Margin is a proposed evaluation tolerance, not a product default.
quality.method: Paired task-level differences in [-1,1]; normal lower confidence bound with sample variance and Bonferroni over three arms and two decision routes. Report raw discordances and task-cluster bootstrap sensitivity; disagreement => insufficient.
quality.insufficient: Underpowered strata, missing final grades, unsettled calls, duplicated task clusters, or unknown costs => EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT; no GO.

cost.qualityImprovementRoute: Quality lower confidence bound > 0 and upper full-cost ratio <= 1.10
cost.costReductionRoute: Quality lower confidence bound > -0.02 and upper full-cost ratio <= 0.90
cost.rationale: 10% minimum cost reduction exceeds small accounting/cache noise; at most 10% extra cost/latency for a demonstrated quality gain. No measured data was used to set these thresholds.
cost.method: Task-cluster paired bootstrap, seed=950955, 10000 resamples, one-sided Bonferroni bounds; include all failed attempts. Baseline cost zero or incomplete => unknown ratio.
cost.unknown: null propagates through totals; record known subtotal separately; price/model version missing prevents monetary decision; no character-to-token substitution; cache tokens recorded once in their provider category.

maintenanceLimits.reason: Leave at least six of eight continuation actions for task work and bound repeated failed recall. Both offline arms share the same limits.

freezeRule: Thresholds and oracle do not change after outputs. Changed input gets a new version; retain first failures. New live plan must bind actual corpus/provider/model/candidate/budgets and obtain matching authorization.
